senses.gloss: (cmp. קָדַד) to sting, point, puncture, break through.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 2:2:4">Y. Keth. II, 26ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>לבי נוֹקְדֵינִי</he> my conscience stings me (I am afraid that I may have sinned); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 10:3:5">Y. Yeb. X, 11ᵃ</cite> top <he>נוקריני</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Gittin 56a:8">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>נ̇ק̇ד̇ימון</he>) <he>שנָ֗קְ֗דָ֗ה לו חמה בעבורו</he> for his sake did the sun break through again (after being obscured); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 809:3">Yalk. Deut. 809</cite>; <cite ref="Taanit 20a:5">Taan. 20ᵃ</cite> Ms. M. (ed. <he>שנקדרה</he>).
Ib. אילו לא נ׳ החמה Ms. M. (ed. נקדרה). [Ib. שלשה נקדה Ms. M. (ed. נקדמה, read, as Ab. Zar. 25ᵃ: עמדה.]—2) (Massorah) to dot, mark with diacritical points.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 34:5">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXXIV</cite>, <he>כבר נָקַדְתִּי עליהן</he> I (Ezra) have marked these words with dots.—Part. pass. <cite ref="N01199"><he>נָקיּד</he></cite>.
Ib. נ׳ על י׳ שביניך there is a dot over the Yod of benekhah (Gen. XVI, 6).
Snh. 43ᵇ למה נ׳ על לנו וכ׳ why are there dots over lanu &c. (Deut. XXIX, 28)? Pes. IX, 2 לפיכך נ׳ על וכ׳ therefore the Hé (of רחקה, Num. IX, 10) is marked &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:3">Maasr. I, 3</cite> <he>החרובים משיִנָּקְדוּ</he> carobs are subject to tithes as soon as they get dark spots; Y. ib. 48ᵈ bot. <he>משיִנָּקֵידוּ</he>.
